messages:
Maya Patel: quick sync — we need to lock the onboarding scope for the next cohort. customers asking for a pinned model option during migration windows. thoughts?
Jordan Lee: pinning is fine but we need clear rollback criteria + perf/regression benchmarks. otherwise ops load skyrockets.
Priya Nair: +1. from PM side, customers want a 30d grace path with pin as a paid add-on. need acceptance gates: perf delta, embed drift, and cost impact.
Sam Ortiz: can we define the perf gate as token-level latency < +15% and generation quality drop < 2% on our eval set? also require canary at 5% traffic for 48h.
Diego Ramos: 2% quality drop is pretty strict for some quantized variants. recommend: separate gates for QA-targeted prompts vs general prompts — e.g., <1.5% on high-signal evals, <4% on long-tail.
Maya Patel: ok — propose we add a "bench bucket" matrix: high-signal, mid, long-tail. each has target thresholds and sample sizes. we'll publish the matrix to sales.
Priya Nair: sales needs wording for contracts: "pinning is time-limited and subject to deprecation windows with 30d notice unless SLA purchased." we should confirm legal + finance.
Jordan Lee: implementation notes: pinned routing will map tenant->model_version in routing table. need DB migration for version history and fallback policy. Sam, can you estimate infra work?
Sam Ortiz: rough: 2 sprint changes: routing + admin UI + canary hooks + metrics. add a runbook for automated fallback (if canary fails).
Diego Ramos: quantization note: some pinned variants will be quantized-int8 for cost. we must record quant profile metadata so we can surface expected regressions to customers.
Maya Patel: good call. include quant_profile and perf_profile in model metadata. that helps customer comms.
Priya Nair: launch criteria checklist draft: 1) bench matrix green, 2) canary 5% 48h, 3) rollback tested in staging, 4) legal: pin terms in contract, 5) ops runbook and oncall training.
Jordan Lee: add 6) telemetry: token cost, latency P95, hallucination rate on eval probes.
Sam Ortiz: I'll attach a minimal canary config snippet here:
```yaml
canary:
  percent: 5
  window: 48h
  success_metrics:
    - latency_p95 < 1.15 * baseline
    - quality_delta < threshold_by_bucket
    - error_rate < 0.5%
```
Diego Ramos: for quality_delta, we'll compute BLEU/ROUGE-ish proxies + embedding-sim drift. add human review flag if delta > threshold.
Maya Patel: ops question — if pinned model is retired, what's customer path? auto-swap to closest compatible variant? notify + opt-in for migration?
Priya Nair: prefer notify + auto-swap only if customer opted into auto-migrate in contract. otherwise offer migration support and temporary free trial for new variant.
Jordan Lee: technical feasibility: auto-swap needs compatibility matrix and fallback weights. it's doable but needs clear policy to avoid silent changes in customer outputs.
Diego Ramos: also need an eval harness to validate semantic parity before auto-swap. we can run ~1k sampled prompts and compute embedding similarity > 0.92 as a gate.
Maya Patel: action items: Jordan + Sam produce infra estimate + runbook, Diego + Eng-ML produce bench matrix and eval harness, Priya to draft contract language and comms, I'll coordinate with sales for pilot customers.
Sam Ortiz: estimated 3 devs x 2 sprints to get MVP. extra 1 sprint for canary tooling and runbook exercises. QOL: add admin flag to force-unpin for support.
Priya Nair: comms: draft email template for customers when a pin is requested/approved and when pins are scheduled for deprecation. include FAQs about quality, cost, and migration options.
Elena (eng-bot): reminder: retention policy requires storing model_version mappings and canary outcomes for 90 days. link: https://redwood.internal/infra/policies/model-pinning
releaseman (bot): deploy scheduled: canary-service v2 -> staging at 2024-11-02T18:00Z.
Maya Patel: thanks all — I'll circulate the checklist + timeline by EOD. try to keep the wording customer-friendly; avoid ops jargon in the contract copy.
Jordan Lee: FYI — tagging @Sam for oncall run-through next week.
Sam Ortiz: ack, will prep a short tabletop runbook for oncall.
Priya Nair: pinging sales to nominate two pilot customers who want pinning. need to prioritize by revenue impact and technical fit.
Diego Ramos: one more: ensure pin metadata includes quantized_fingerprint and baseline_eval_hash so we can link regressions later.
Maya Patel: noted. meeting wrap — will track tasks in the roadmap ticket and link to this thread. :handshake:
